Subject: Request: extended POC & credits for HydraWorks integration

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at HydraWorks is excited about Redwood. We're preparing a short POC to validate latency/cost for our customer-facing workflow and need two favors to make the timeline realistic: a 6-week trial extension beyond the standard 30 days, and a one-time credit to cover the initial evaluation runs (estimated ~25k tokens/day).

Would Redwood be willing to consider a 45-day extension (starting 2/20) and a $30k promotional credit to be applied during the POC? If approved, we'll sign the SOW draft and commit to an integration review by the end of Q2. I've attached a short scope doc.

Appreciate your help — Kenji (CTO) is copied and available for a quick call if needed.

Best,
Lina
Lina Morales | Head of Platform Partnerships
HydraWorks

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear ask and the scope doc. I think this is a good fit for a promotional top-up and a short extension; before I lock it in I need an authorization from our pricing committee.

Marissa, looping you in for approval and to confirm the commercial parameters. My suggested starting point: 45-day extension (start 2/20), $30k promo credit applied pro-rata over the trial, plus a one-time 35% first-quarter discount on committed usage if they convert within 60 days of POC completion. Can you confirm whether that’s within approval bounds or whether we should escalate to exec sign-off?

Lina/Kenji — I'll update you once we have confirmation (should be within a few business days).

Thanks,

Forwarding HydraWorks request — recapping with recommended terms and impact:

Proposal summary (recommended):
- Trial extension: 45 days (2/20–4/05)
- Promotional credit: $30,000 applied to account during POC (non-recoupable)
- Conversion sweetener: 35% discount on committed usage for first quarter post-conversion (requires 6-month committed minimum)

Commercial impact (approx):
- Expected usage during POC: ~25k tokens/day, cost delta to Redwood if no promo: ~$4k–$5k net over trial; with 30k credit this becomes marginally revenue negative short term but high upside on conversion.
- Strategic: HydraWorks is a strong reference target (healthcare marketplace integration).

Attachments: HydraWorks-Proposal-20280214.xlsx (added)

Requesting approval to apply the $30k credit + discount sweetener. If this needs exec sign-off, please advise; otherwise Priyom will finalize SOW and close loop with the customer.

Thanks,
Marissa

Marissa — quick Qs before I sign off:
1) Is the $30k credit purely promotional (no clawback) and limited to token consumption during the POC?
2) Do we have an estimate for ARR upside if they convert at the recommended discount? (approx band is fine)
3) Any tech risk that would make this a costly support lift (on-call, custom dev)?

If answers are as you outlined, I'm comfortable approving up to $25k in credits at my level; anything >$25k needs Aditya OK. I believe 35% discount on committed usage is fine as long as we require a 6-month minimum and include ramp milestones in the SOW.

Cheers,
Naomi
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
